out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device Used to Check Sanitizer Conc
violations.observation: The operator is not testing the chemical sanitizing solution to ensure proper concentration of the solution.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed 61f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. MISSION BBQ NOVA CATERING (Inspection Date: 04/03/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed dish machine not working properly and equipment not effectively sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. CDI 3 compartment sink set up to sanitize and all equipment resanitized inside sink

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. Hot water heater not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CDI sink used to sanitize dishes.

out_items.name: Proper reheating procedures for hot holding

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Temp Reached within 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding within a sufficient time of 2 hours or less: vegetables reheated for hot holding and warmed up in hot box did not reach 165f in 2 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Reheating food for hot holding shall be done rapidly, within 2 hours to prevent growth of pathogens. Reheat food in ovens rapidly. CDI discarded

violations.title: Reheating for Hot Holding, Proper Temp
violations.observation: The following food item(s) was not reheated for hot holding to a sufficient temperature and/or time: Mac n cheese noodles cooked/cooled the previous day reheated to 150f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding shall be reheated to a minimum temperature of 165F for 15 seconds. CDI reheated to 165f

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: canned green beans 48- 55f in WIC for 5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CDI beans discarded. EHS recommends pre cooling bean cans before opening.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling canned beans and cooked bacon in deep metal container with lids on.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI remove lid and use shallow container. Pre cool cans before opening.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat solution was measured at 500ppm in sanitizer bucket and sink. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat solution at 200ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI water added to dilute solution.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Reduced Oxygen Packaged fish thawing without removing from packaging per manufacturer instructions.
violations.corrective_action: All Reduced Oxygen Packaged fish shall be removed from the anaerobic environment while thawing. CDI plastic packages were cut to allow airflow and finish thawing in refrigerator.
